proof_summary: The counterexample is \(736\): an exhaustive finite search over nondecreasing sums of at most four squares rules out every representation whose bases are all at least \(8\) (while, for example, \(736=4^2+12^2+24^2\)). Thus every admissible representation has least base at most \(7\), so the largest possible least base is at most \(7\) even though \(736>599\).
